# Shangri-La Yunnan Travel Guide

> Complete travel planning hub for Shangri-La, Yunnan, China. Attractions, weather, altitude guide, hotels, transport, costs, food, and FAQs — all verified on the road, last updated August 2026.

## Attractions
- [Pudacuo National Park](https://www.shangri-la-yunnan.com/attractions/pudacuo-national-park/) — Alpine lakes, wetlands, rare black-necked cranes
- [Songzanlin Monastery](https://www.shangri-la-yunnan.com/attractions/songzanlin-monastery/) — Largest Tibetan Buddhist monastery in Yunnan (1679)
- [Dukezong Old Town](https://www.shangri-la-yunnan.com/attractions/dukezong-old-town/) — 1,300-year-old Tibetan quarter, world's largest prayer wheel
- [Napa Lake](https://www.shangri-la-yunnan.com/attractions/napa-lake/) — Seasonal highland lake, yak grazing, mountain backdrop
- [Tiger Leaping Gorge](https://www.shangri-la-yunnan.com/attractions/tiger-leaping-gorge/) — World-class 2-day trek, one of deepest river gorges
- [Meili Snow Mountain](https://www.shangri-la-yunnan.com/attractions/meili-snow-mountain/) — Sacred 6,740m peak, iconic sunrise at Feilai Temple
- [Balagezong Canyon](https://www.shangri-la-yunnan.com/attractions/balagezong-canyon/) — Hanging coffins, glass skywalk, Tibetan villages
- [Baishuitai Terraces](https://www.shangri-la-yunnan.com/attractions/baishuitai-terraces/) — Natural travertine pools, "China's Pamukkale"
- [Haba Snow Mountain](https://www.shangri-la-yunnan.com/attractions/haba-snow-mountain/) — Accessible 5,396m summit climb for fit beginners

## Food & Culture
- [Yak Butter Tea](https://www.shangri-la-yunnan.com/food/yak-butter-tea/) — Traditional Tibetan staple beverage
- [Yak Hotpot](https://www.shangri-la-yunnan.com/food/yak-hotpot/) — Highland comfort food with mushrooms
- [Tsampa](https://www.shangri-la-yunnan.com/food/tsampa/) — Roasted barley flour, Tibetan daily bread
- [Matsutake Mushrooms](https://www.shangri-la-yunnan.com/food/matsutake-mushrooms/) — Seasonal Yunnan delicacy (July-September)
- [Tibetan Barley Wine](https://www.shangri-la-yunnan.com/food/tibetan-barley-wine/) — Fermented highland barley alcohol
- [Morning Chanting](https://www.shangri-la-yunnan.com/food/morning-chanting/) — 6:30 AM Buddhist ceremony at Songzanlin
- [Tibetan Toast Feast](https://www.shangri-la-yunnan.com/food/tibetan-toast-feast/) — Chieftain-style banquet with bonfire circle dance

## Key Facts
- Shangri-La city sits at 3,160 m (10,370 ft) in Diqing Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan, China
- Best months: May and September-October; July-August is monsoon season
- No special travel permit required (unlike Tibet Autonomous Region); a standard Chinese visa applies
- Diqing Shangri-La Airport (DIG) connects to Kunming; ~3.5 h by road from Lijiang
- Part of the UNESCO Three Parallel Rivers World Heritage property (inscribed 2003)
